implementation_basis: Native reconstruction from REP arXiv v6, applied to the existing CODA host
upstream_license_observation: REP repository code is CC BY-NC4.0; this native paper reconstruction does not relabel or bundle that code as MIT

host_contract.query: Frozen Tiny with the same pinned IN21K-to-IN1K AugReg family
host_contract.optimizer_scheduler: Existing CODA Adam and task-wise cosine; common20-epoch recipe, not paper1875 iterations
host_contract.evaluation: All blocks execute, merging remains deterministic, query/projection remain enabled

explicit_reconstruction_choices: Gaussian fixed query projection192->D, divided by sqrt192; registered persistent buffer initialized with seed+1
Progressive local merge maximum16 is a configurable engineering default; the missing author runner does not establish r_max
ALD minimum=.5 and gamma=.001 follow public component defaults; alpha=.9 follows paper
Tiny spatial threshold8 and Base12 follow the paper; Small10 is an explicit adaptation
ALD uses the local planned merge count capped by currently available image tokens, then skips the whole block before execution
Use >= at the spatial threshold as Eq6; Algorithm2 prints >
First optimizer update executes every block, following full-keep initialization text; this is an explicit exception to Eq5 at t=0
Time is absolute optimizer-update count within the task, advanced once by observe and reset at a new task; gamma is not silently rescaled across batch sizes
AToM excludes CLS from matching and CODA prefix K/V are never in the image-token sequence
Weighted token masses become additive log attention biases; prefix keys have mass1
Native SDPA attention returns image-only mean-key metrics for merging
Checkpoint includes query weights, fixed projection, task/update counters and separate CPU ALD RNG state
No automatic sweep, auxiliary teacher, replay buffer, GPU run or inferred energy savings
source_issues_addressed: Replace hardcoded1024 projection width with the host encoder dimension
Persist projection instead of a lazy plain Tensor
Advance ALD timestep once per optimizer update, rather than per block or with a probability as the timestep
Explicitly activate progressive merging without an unavailable runner
Keep prefix keys separate from image tokens and align metrics/masses correctly
Use explicit native classes rather than source isinstance patching
Avoid source per-forward CUDA event/synchronize instrumentation
accuracy_gate: CPU structural tests and paired host controls; the1.5/3pp independent-author accuracy gate remains pending a complete independent reference
